title: Roles and Capability Matrix
summary: Details role defaults, optional permission extensions, and capability evaluation order.

sections.title: Authorization model
paragraphs: RAPTOR combines role defaults with optional permission extensions. This preserves predictable baseline behavior while allowing targeted capability expansion when required.

rows: Broad access across dashboard, records, security, and settings.
Security workflow actions plus pentest export.
Record visibility and controlled record updates.

sections.title: Capability evaluation order
paragraphs: Effective permissions are computed in a fixed order to keep frontend and backend authorization behavior consistent.
orderedList: Apply admin full-access behavior when role is `admin`.
Evaluate route and action checks against merged capability set.

sections.title: Access governance
paragraphs: Use least-privilege defaults and grant additional permissions only for clear operational need. Review elevated permissions periodically and remove stale grants.
list: Prefer targeted optional grants over broad role changes.
Document why sensitive permissions were granted.
Review elevated access on a regular cadence.
